wake.note: Events are persisted and retrievable. MCP tools are pull-based: the host must call worker_wait or worker_events to observe them. The supervisor does not claim the ability to wake the main agent in the background.

runtimes.notes: Native Pi RPC. Steering and follow-ups use Pi queues. Cancellation uses abort. Resume loads a persisted Pi session file; pause is not supported.
